dec.pe: A man from Côte d’Ivoire with a disability, living lawfully in France, was refused an allowance because he was not French or from a treaty country. The Court found discrimination.
dec.pi: Seorang pria penyandang disabilitas dari Pantai Gading yang tinggal sah di Prancis ditolak tunjangan karena bukan warga Prancis atau negara mitra perjanjian. Mahkamah menemukan diskriminasi.

dec.pe: A teenager from Togo was made to work in a home in Paris for years without pay or rest. The European Court said France broke the Convention because its criminal law did not properly punish servitude. France changed its law.
dec.pi: Seorang remaja dari Togo dipaksa bekerja di sebuah rumah di Paris bertahun-tahun tanpa upah dan istirahat. Pengadilan HAM Eropa menyatakan Prancis melanggar Konvensi karena hukum pidananya tidak cukup menghukum perhambaan. Prancis mengubah undang-undangnya.

dec.pe: A family from Kazakhstan, with a baby and a three-year-old, was held for two weeks in an immigration detention centre. The Court said this harmed the children and broke the Convention.
dec.pi: Sebuah keluarga dari Kazakhstan, dengan bayi dan anak tiga tahun, ditahan dua minggu di pusat detensi imigrasi. Mahkamah menyatakan ini merugikan anak dan melanggar Konvensi.
